name: create_feedback_report
description: Generate and save a private report from this run's selected feedback sources. Preferred: pass comment_evidence_id and/or danmaku_evidence_id exactly matching the sources selected for this task, using completed analyze_comments/analyze_danmaku results. Legacy alternative: pass evidence_id of an already-completed analyze_feedback asset by itself. Never mix evidence_id with the per-source ids, never send blank ids, and never use evidence from another run. With source evidence the host starts budgeted background reading and synthesis, validates complete coverage and persists HTML before READY; the host waits on PENDING, so do not poll.

evidence_id.description: Legacy only: completed current-run feedback evidence returned by analyze_feedback. Do not combine with comment_evidence_id or danmaku_evidence_id.

comment_evidence_id.description: Required when COMMENT is selected: current-run analyze_comments source evidence.

danmaku_evidence_id.description: Required when DANMAKU is selected: current-run analyze_danmaku source evidence.
